Bill.BriefDescription: Assigning a seriousness level to selected unranked felonies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assigning a seriousness level to selectedunranked felonies; reenacting and amending RCW 9.94A.515; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:
